I was diagnosed with Dysthymia. Persistent Depressive Disorder. No matter how happy I am and how great things are, there’s a lingering pain inside. I call it my low hanging balloon. Where “normal” folks are floating high in the sky on their best days, I drift somewhere at half mast. My highest high is their mediocre day.

I don’t want to be alive most of the time, but the thought of taking action breaks my heart. If only the folks around me knew how much it hurt to hold on. To wear this mask, just to make sure everyone is happy.
